messages:
Priya K.: Quick ask — we need one more panelist for Wed 2pm PT for the Sr Infra loop. Anyone able to cover remotely? Also short rubric question: are we using 50/50 system-design vs behavioral now, or still 60/40? Link to doc: https://redwoodinternal/rubrics/sr-infra
Alex M.: I can cover remote if it's confirmed at 2pm PT. Candidate timezone ok? :+1:
Priya K.: Candidate is PST-friendly, remote is fine. Thanks Alex! Re: weights — I thought we moved to 50/50 last week but wasn't sure if that was live.
Jordan L.: I updated the rubric file on Friday but didn't blast the panel email. Canonical is 50/50 now — consolidated note (copied here):
```
rubric_weights:
  system_design: 0.5
  behavioral: 0.5
  production_ex: 0.2  # used as tie-breaker / context, not summed into primary score
```
Priya K.: Nice, thanks Jordan. Quick process Q: for debrief, do we want the condensed 1-5 + short notes form, or full narrative? Candidate did a take-home and the loop is tight.
Elena R.: Use condensed 1-5 with 1-2 line supporting note unless something is a clear hire/blocker. Saves time for hiring committee.
Alex M.: I'll take the slot and be the scribe for debrief. @Elena R. can you own the production-ex question?
Elena R.: Yep I got production_ex. Will prep a short prompt and share 30 min before.
Priya K.: Awesome. Action: Alex cover Wed 2pm PT (scribe), Elena owns production question, Jordan will push a short note to the panel about the 50/50 weight. I'll update the calendar invite to note condensed debrief. :white_check_mark:
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Panel checklist — join 5m early, confirm recording consent, use standard panel form https://redwoodinternal/panels/form. Debrief form will auto-open 30m after the interview ends.
Alex M.: Got it — will join 5m early. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
Jordan L.: I'll ping the hiring manager & post a one-line update in the calendar.
Priya K.: Thanks team — I'll close the loop on the invite and post the short rubric note in the panel thread.
